name: University of Michigan - Academic Transcript (landscape, two-column record)
description: University of Michigan 'Academic Transcript of:' layout. Landscape pages. The header band holds the student name, student ID number, control number and date issued; a short code block under it on some transcripts is kept in the header band. Record pages are read as two columns split at x=400, left column first. Possible blocks: degrees awarded (School/College, Field(s) of Specialization, Degree, Awarded), non-UM academic experience (school name and city/state/zip), advanced placement credit (SUBJ 123 Title Credits), and the undergraduate/graduate record between BEGINNING OF and END OF lines. The record may open with a transfer credit block ('Transfer Course Credit Accepted towards' plus a career line with MSH/CTP/MHP). Term headings are '<Season> <Year> <Career> Grade Hours MSH CTP MHP'; course rows 'SUBJ 123 Title [Grade] Hours MSH CTP MHP', optionally followed by a topic line; 'Term Total' lines; a career line plus 'Cumulative Total [GPA: x] MSH CTP MHP'. Terms following a transfer block are labelled with the university and the career without its level word, and their course rows carry the MSH value as a note. Undergraduate remarks (dated honors/events), graduate remarks (dated text, possibly wrapped), dissertation and committee lines and general remarks follow; reading stops at 'End of Transcript'. TRANSCRIPT GUIDE pages are skipped and their legend is copied as the grading scale (the Fail grade, printed twice in the legend, is listed once). The 'not an official transcript' notice is kept as a remark. Built on two samples.

notes: Read by App-parser (University of Michigan 'Academic Transcript' layout, no AI). Values are as printed; course credits are the Hours column, credits earned the CTP column and quality points the MHP column. The legend prints the Fail grade twice; the grading scale lists it once.
